images.description: Home live row (option E): dot over "8m" in the tile, episode title, newest preview words trimmed at the start.
Home live row before a title exists: "Listening now" over the start-trimmed preview line.
Home live row with no preview text: today's subtitle without the duration ("Live").
Home live row at the largest accessibility text size: preview takes two lines, tile scales down, nothing clips.
Summary: one-line header, So far with on-device bullets and the On this phone tag, Live card with Open transcript and a lighter volatile tail.
Summary when the on-device notes engine is unavailable: the quiet line, no tag.
Summary with six server running notes: the newest four only; the rest arrive with the wrap-up.
Summary with on-device notes, dark mode.
Transcript: final lines, the Live on this phone divider, the uncovered preview tail, and the quiet behind-line at the bottom.
Transcript with no on-device engine: the Recording safely card.
Summary at the largest accessibility text size: header and tabs clamp, cards stack their title and tag.
Uploaded audio awaiting a final transcript: the catching-up line remains visible while preview text is uncovered.
Home preview in Japanese: leading ellipsis and newest graphemes retained at the end.
Continues pill retains its compact visual inside a minimum 44 pt tap target.
